notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001666700-26-000013). Continuing-operations basis throughout: net sales, operating cash flow, capex and cash interest and taxes are all for continuing operations, after the November 1, 2025 Qnity (electronics) spin-off and with the Aramids business (sold April 1, 2026) in discontinued operations; discontinued operations provided 852 of operating cash and are excluded. Not comparable with the FY2024 edition, which included the electronics business. Interest paid is tagged only with a company-specific concept, so it carries no xbrl object. "Acquisitions of property and businesses, net of cash acquired" (55) is one combined line that includes business acquisitions, so it is excluded. The 4,100 distribution received from Electronics at spin-off is a financing inflow and does not affect the formula.
